briefdescription.para: Add a hard link to a file.

detaileddescription.para: Here hard links are not intended to be fully equivalent to the classical filesystem. Both the hard link and the file share the same buffer and status (and thus have the same UniqueID). Because of this there is no way to distinguish between the link and the file after the link has been added.

The Target path must be an existing file or a hardlink. The NewLink file must not have been added before. The Target path must not be a directory. The NewLink node is added as a hard link which points to the resolved file of Target node.
true if the above condition is satisfied and hardlink was successfully created, false otherwise.
